name: Discoid Lateral Meniscus
definition: Congenital variant in which the lateral meniscus is abnormally broad/thick, sometimes causing snapping, pain, locking or tears.

investigations.principle: MRI confirms discoid morphology and associated tear.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Activity-guided rehab for mild stable symptoms
amber: Persistent symptomatic unstable tears may require arthroscopic saucerization/repair.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Sandhi structural phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Congenital variant in which the lateral meniscus is abnormally broad/thick, sometimes causing snapping, pain, locking or tears.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
